Design a modern two-floor home on a 30 × 50 ft plot with the road on the south. On the ground floor, include a living room, dining area, kitchen, one guest bedroom, one shared bathroom, a front sit-out, and parking for one car. On the first floor, include two bedrooms, one shared bathroom, and a balcony. Place the staircase in a dedicated stairwell connected to the hall, with clear landings on both floors. Keep living and dining connected, place the kitchen beside dining, and provide bedroom access from the hall. Include exterior windows for daylight and ventilation.
